feat(quiz): confetti from 80% right, fireworks for all right

## Intent

Finishing a quiz well should feel like a success. Learners who answer at least 80% right see confetti; those who get everything right see fireworks, as in the Textcheck app.

## Key changes

- The quiz engine starts confetti on the result when at least 80% of the answers are right, and fireworks when all are right.
- The quiz stylesheet draws both animations; they stay hidden when the system asks for reduced motion.
